import importlib.util
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('taskprog',p)
mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
def grid(n, pts):
    g=[[0]*n for _ in range(n)]
    for r,c,v in pts:g[r][c]=v
    return g
for n,pts in [(10,[(4,3,1),(7,5,2)]),(10,[(2,3,3),(5,6,1)]),(10,[(2,4,3),(4,6,2)]),(11,[(4,5,2),(6,3,6),(9,7,1)])]:
    o=mod.transform(grid(n,pts))
    print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in o),'\n---')
